async def act(page):
    # Step 1: Locate the searchbox and fill with 'playbook'
    searchbox = page.get_by_role("search").get_by_role("searchbox", name="Search")
    await searchbox.fill("playbook")
    
    # Step 2: Click the search button
    search_button = page.get_by_role("search").get_by_role("button", name="Search")
    await search_button.click()
    
    # Wait for the search results to load
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # Step 3: Identify search result links
    # Assume results are links under the main content area or similar
    # Try to get links within 'main' role first
    result_links = page.get_by_role("main").get_by_role("link")
    result_count = await result_links.count()
    
    if result_count >= 2:
        # Click the second-to-last link
        second_to_last_link = result_links.nth(result_count - 2)
        await second_to_last_link.click()
    else:
        # If not enough links in 'main', try getting all links on the page
        all_links = page.get_by_role("link")
        all_count = await all_links.count()
        if all_count >= 2:
            second_to_last_all = all_links.nth(all_count - 2)
            await second_to_last_all.click()
        else:
            # Fallback: click the first link if only one result
            await result_links.first.click()
